uncuff.description: Releases the specified player from handcuffs.

jail_help.description: Shows the specified page in jail menu.

jail_throw.description: Jails the specified player in an empty jail.

jail_create.description: Creates a jail at your current location.

jail_remove.description: Removes the jail with the specified id.

jail_release.description: Releases the specified player from jail.

jail_info.description: Shows information about the specified jail.

jail_teleport.description: Teleports to the specified jail. The tp alias works too.

jail_setexit.description: Without jailId: sets the GLOBAL release exit (used by every jail that has no specific exit). With jailId: sets the exit for that specific jail, overriding the global.

cop_help.description: Shows the specified page in cop menu.

cop_list.description: Shows the players being chased by cops. The player is optional: with one, shows that player's cops.

cop_spawner_set.description: Sets a cop spawner at your current location.

cop_spawner_remove.description: Removes the cop spawner with the specified id.

cop_spawner_list.description: Shows all the available cop spawners.

cop_spawner_info.description: Shows the information of the cop spawner with the specified id.

cop_spawner_teleport.description: Teleports the player to the cop spawner with the specified id. The tp alias works too.

cop_setup_wand.description: Gives you the setup wand: left-click a block for pos1, right-click for pos2.

cop_setup_mode.description: Chooses what the next save stores. Station and pickup use pos1 only, the others a cuboid.

cop_setup_save.description: Stores the wand selection under a name according to the mode (a station also takes the spawners near it).

cop_setup_list.description: Lists the stations, regions and points: kind id name world x y z [tags].

cop_setup_remove.description: Removes a station, region or point (a station frees its spawners).

cop_setup_tp.description: Teleports you to a station, a point, or the centre of a region.

cop_setup_link.description: Sets the jail a station books arrests into, or none to unlink it.
